name: Reachability Analysis Source
description: The source role of the Reachability Analyzer compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): the first component of an analysis's ForwardPathComponents, in SequenceNumber order -> the analysis, the middle node. Written only when the analysis succeeded and found a path (NetworkPathFound). The sources are the types the Reachability Analyzer guide lists as sources and destinations. The analysis retires with this end (COMPOUND_EDGE retires_with). Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/network_insights.py (aws-core-tap#212, #248).
